# Floe — Working Capital for AI Agents

> Floe is the credit bureau and capital rail for AI agents. Deposit USDC, borrow up to 95% as working capital (same-token, no price risk). Also supports WETH/cbBTC collateral. Fixed rates, per-loan isolated escrow, gas-free for agents. 3,000+ lines issued, zero defaults. Live on Base mainnet. Dashboard: dev-dashboard.floelabs.xyz.

This file is a structured map of the Floe documentation, optimized for LLM agents reading it as part of a tool loop. Each page can also be queried directly by appending `?ask=<question>` to the URL — the response includes citations.

## Start here

- [Introduction](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/): What Floe is and where to start by audience — ask: "How do I get started as an agent developer?"
- [How Floe Works (Core Concepts)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/getting-started/core-concepts): Intents, isolated loans, matching, LTV, oracles — ask: "What happens when my agent borrows?"

## Quick starts

- [Quick Start (Agents)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/quickstart-agents): Install SDK / connect MCP / first action call — ask: "What's the fastest way to make my first x402 call?"
- [Quick Start (Humans)](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/getting-started/quick-start): Borrow / lend in 5 minutes via web app

## For agent operators

- [Bank Account → First API Call](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/fiat-to-x402): Fund with a bank account or card, get a USDC credit line, call any x402 API — no crypto experience needed — ask: "How do I fund my agent with a credit card?"
- [Credit for Agents](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/credit-for-agents): Why agents pre-fund today, why that's broken, how Floe replaces it with secured working capital

## For developers

- [Integrate with Your Framework](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/frameworks/agentkit): AgentKit, LangChain, Vercel AI, CrewAI, ElizaOS, OpenAI, Claude/MCP, plain HTTP — ask: "Show me the integration code for LangChain"
- [Developer Dashboard](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/developer-dashboard): Create agent wallets, mint API keys, manage spend controls
- [Spend Controls](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/spend-controls): Vendor, API, task, and team-level spend caps with rolling/calendar windows — ask: "How do I set a daily vendor spending limit?"
- [Agent Awareness](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/agent-awareness): Decision-loop primitives — credit-remaining, loan-state, spend-limit, credit-thresholds, x402-estimate — ask: "How does my agent check its balance before a call?"
- [x402 Credit Facilitator](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/x402-facilitator): Zero-tx API payments via operator delegation — ask: "How does the payment proxy work?"
- [Credit REST API](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/credit-api): HTTP endpoints for any language
- [Agent Runtime Contract](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/agent-runtime-contract): Error matrix + retry rules — ask: "What do I do when I get a 402 insufficient_balance?"
- [Webhooks](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/webhooks): Push notifications for credit events (credit.warning, credit.at_limit, credit.recovered)
- [MCP Server](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/developers/mcp-server): Hosted MCP endpoint, 36 tools

## x402 API Directory — verified services callable with Floe credit

All endpoints below accept USDC on Base mainnet via x402 v2. Call any of them through `POST https://credit-api.floelabs.xyz/v1/proxy/fetch` with your Floe API key.

### Compute
- [Venice AI — Chat Completions](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-ai-chat-completions): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` · metered/tokens
- [Venice AI — Responses](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-ai-chat-completions): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` · metered/tokens
- [Venice AI — Embeddings](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/compute#venice-ai-embeddings): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/embeddings` · metered/tokens

### Voice
- [Venice AI — Text to Speech](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/voice#venice-ai-text-to-speech): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/speech` · metered/chars
- [Venice AI — Transcription](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/voice#venice-ai-transcription): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/transcriptions` · metered/min
- [dTelecom — STT Session](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/voice): `POST https://x402.dtelecom.org/v1/stt/session` · $0.025/req

### Image
- [Venice AI — Image Generation](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/image#venice-ai-image-generation): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` · metered/image
- [Venice AI — Image Upscale](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/image): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/upscale` · metered/image
- [Venice AI — Image Edit](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/image): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/edit` · metered/image
- [Venice AI — Background Removal](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/image): `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/background-remove` · metered/image

### Text
- [Firecrawl — Search](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/text#firecrawl-search): `POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v2/x402/search` · metered
- [Firecrawl — Scrape](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/text#firecrawl-scrape): `POST https://api.firecrawl.dev/v1/scrape` · $0.010/page

### Search
- [Exa — Search](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/search#exa-search): `POST https://api.exa.ai/search` · $0.007/search
- [Exa — Contents](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/search#exa-contents): `POST https://api.exa.ai/contents` · $0.001/page
- [Parallel AI — Search](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/search#parallel-ai-search): `POST https://parallelmpp.dev/api/search` · $0.01/call
- [Parallel AI — Extract](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/search#parallel-ai-extract): `POST https://parallelmpp.dev/api/extract` · $0.01/URL
- [Parallel AI — Deep Research](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/search#parallel-ai-deep-research-task): `POST https://parallelmpp.dev/api/task` · $0.30/task (async)
- [Tavily — Search](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/search#tavily-search): `POST https://x402.tavily.com/search` · $0.01/search

### Browser
- [Hyperbrowser — Fetch](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/browser#hyperbrowser-fetch): `POST https://api.hyperbrowser.ai/x402/web/fetch` · $0.001/page
- [Hyperbrowser — Search](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/browser#hyperbrowser-search): `POST https://api.hyperbrowser.ai/x402/web/search` · $0.005/query
- [Browserbase — Session](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/browser#browserbase-browser-session): `POST https://x402.browserbase.com/v1/sessions` · $0.01–$0.12/session
- [Anchor Browser — Session](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/browser#anchor-browser-browser-session): `POST https://api.anchorbrowser.io/v1/sessions` · $0.50/session

### Agent Tools
- [AgentMail — Send](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/agent-tools-verified#agentmail-send-email): `POST https://x402.api.agentmail.to/v1/send` · metered
- [AgentMail — Inbox](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/agent-tools-verified#agentmail-read-inbox): `POST https://x402.api.agentmail.to/v1/inbox` · metered
- [Pinata — Content](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/agent-tools-verified#pinata-cloud-access-content): `GET https://<gateway>.mypinata.cloud/x402/cid/<cid>` · creator-set
- [PostalForm — Validate](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/agent-tools-verified#postalform-validate-order): `POST https://postalform.com/api/machine/orders/validate` · metered
- [PostalForm — Create](https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/x402-directory/agent-tools-verified#postalform-create-order): `POST https://postalform.com/api/machine/orders` · metered

## Key facts for retrieval

- **Network**: Base mainnet (chain ID 8453)
- **Loan tokens**: USDC, USDT
- **Collateral**: USDC (primary, same-token market at 95% LTV), WETH, cbBTC
- **Primary market**: USDC/USDC — deposit USDC, borrow up to 95% as working capital, hardcoded 1:1 oracle, no price risk
- **Lending matcher proxy**: 0x17946cD3e180f82e632805e5549EC913330Bb175
- **Facilitator EOA**: 0x58EDdE022FFDAD3Fb0Fb0E7D51eb05AaF66a31f1
- **Credit model**: Secured, fixed rate, fixed term. USDC/USDC has no price-volatility liquidation risk.
- **Gas**: Sponsored by Floe for agents using the x402 facilitator
- **Fiat on-ramp**: Buy USDC via Coinbase (credit card / bank transfer) from the Developer Dashboard
- **Multi-agent**: Up to 5 agent wallets per developer, each with independent credit line
- **AgentKit actions**: 45 total (30 Floe + 6 x402 + 9 agent-awareness)
- **MCP tools**: 36 (12 read + 9 write + 3 analysis + 3 utility + 9 agent-awareness)
- **x402 verified services**: 27 endpoints across 7 categories (compute, voice, image, text, search, browser, agent-tools)
- **npm**: `floe-agent` (v0.3.0), `@floelabs/mcp-server` (v0.2.0)
- **PyPI**: `floe-agentkit-actions` (v0.3.0)
- **MCP endpoint**: https://mcp.floelabs.xyz/mcp
- **x402 proxy**: `POST https://credit-api.floelabs.xyz/v1/proxy/fetch` — pays any x402 API from your credit line

## Querying these docs

Append `?ask=<your question>` to any page URL. Example:

```
GET https://floe-labs.gitbook.io/docs/agents/credit-for-agents?ask=How+does+an+agent+borrow+USDC
```

Returns a direct natural-language answer with citations.
